lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: The farmhouse is up, and I've been rummaging. The old seed-store gave up ten turnip seeds, which is ten more than I had this morning. Here. Take them.

lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: Now, I have a hearth and nothing to put over it, so I'll be plain. Till a patch of the cleared soil, plant them, and water them every day. Every day, mind, or they sulk and you get nothing. Four days, and you will have turnips. There is nowhere to buy more seed yet, so guard those ten. They are the whole of the first crop.

lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: Bring me some when they come up. A kitchen is a very sad room without something to cook.

lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: You have a harvest. Splendid. Bring me three fresh crops and I'll put the hearth to proper use — the first real meal this outpost has seen in years.

lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: The lodging is sorted, and I've found the hearth Tharr mentioned. It is not much yet, but I can work with it. Get some rest tonight. Tomorrow we'll start making this place livable.

lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: The hearth draws well, but the room around it needs a roof and a proper flue. A tavern is only as good as the walls that keep the rain out of the soup.

lines.speaker: fenwick
lines.text: The kitchen is open. Bring me ingredients and I'll turn them into something worth eating. A well-fed party fights better, works harder, and complains less. Mostly less.
